title: Railway panel
description: A nearly full-bleed framed panel with 16px corners, a hairline border and a faint colour wash (steel navy, slate teal or plum), used to group the big sections of a dark page.
notes: the tint is translucent, so put the panel on bg-background
name: railway-panel

props.name: tint
props.description:
a faint colour wash over the page background: chart-5 (steel navy), chart-2 (slate teal),
highlight (plum), or none for a bordered panel in the page colour
